suggested_fix: No fix needed. smb2_compound_op() drops the cfile reference it is given. Before the -EINVAL retry, the function calls cifs_get_writable_path() again, so the retry has its own new reference (or NULL) and does not reuse the one already released. That avoids a use-after-free or double put of cfile. The retry also passes a NULL dentry, so it does not send the lease key again.
